continuation: 海鸥的傍晚已经记在册里。接下来，夜里去住户庭院看看第3只海湾猫安静睡觉；观察后可以改日找Dani分享。
The evening gull note is already in your book. Next, watch harbor cat 3 sleeping in Residents’ Courtyard at night; you can share it with Dani on another day.

title: 各自的作息
Different daily routines
brief: “上次已经记下第3只岸边海鸥傍晚在海岸安静活动。这次请在夜间去住户庭院，安静观察第3只海湾猫睡觉。沿用上次的海鸥记录；别叫醒猫。没有期限。”

“Your earlier note already records shore gull 3 moving quietly in The Coast (evening). This time, quietly watch harbor cat 3 sleeping in Residents’ Courtyard at night. Keep the gull note; let the cat sleep. No deadline.”
page: 我与Dani Costa分享了两段不同时刻的观察：先前在海岸傍晚记下的第3只岸边海鸥安静活动，以及这次夜间在住户庭院看到的第3只海湾猫睡觉。我们都给它们留了空间。
I shared two observations with Dani Costa: the earlier note of shore gull 3 moving quietly in The Coast (evening), and harbor cat 3 sleeping in Residents’ Courtyard at night. We gave them both space.
